injuries.description: Lost distal phalanx in the right index finger.
source: he had lost his distal phalanx in the right index
injuries.icd_description: Traumatic amputation of other single finger

injuries.description: Lost the distal phalanx plus two-thirds of the middle phalanx of the (riddle) finger.
source: and the distal phalanx plus two-thirds of the middle phalanx of the riddle finger.
injuries.icd_description: Traumatic amputation of other single finger

injuries.description: Lost the distal phalanx and one-third of the middle phalanx of the ring finger.
source: In addition thereto the Plaintiff also lost the distal phalanx and one-third of the middle phalanx of the ring finger.
injuries.icd_description: Traumatic amputation of other single finger

manifestations.description: No pain, phantom limb sensations nor numbness.
Grip of his right hand is 70 1bs. as against 110 1bs. with his left hand.
Finds heavy labour and work requiring great dexterity rather difficult.

treatments_received: Initial amputations on the day of the accident
Outpatient visits a few times over next two months
Hospital admission for two days for removal of a remnant nail
Physiotherapy in a clinic for a relatively short while

losses.description: Permanent loss of distal phalanges and parts of middle phalanges of fingers of the right hand (amputations).

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Gave up occasional ten-pin bowling but took up billiards; some minor difficulties in daily life and activities.
